title: Bipolar to Unipolar Converter
text: Map bipolar signal to unipolar signal in range [0, M – 1], 1 input, 1 output, {Output data type} sets Output data type of unipolar signal Inherit via internal; {M-ary number} sets the number of symbols and {Polarity} sets the relative ordering. Values come from the instance.

params.name: Polarity
params.values: Relative ordering of symbols Positive (default) | Negative

params.name: Output data type
params.values: Output data type of unipolar signal Inherit via internal rule (default) | Same as input | double | int8 | int16 | int32 | uint8 | uint16 | uint32 | boolean
